basic_info.description: This Mission Terrace two-bedroom home exudes charm and Mediterranean elegance. It is the first time it has been on the market since the 1930's. It is a time capsule of well maintained fixtures and finishes.  From the refinished original hardwood floors, the arched doorways, the living room picture windows, coved ceiling, pristine original light fixtures, the facade, and tiled exterior stairs, the home revels in classic Mediterranean finishes. The living room captures excellent light with the large windows. It has a handsome wood-burning fireplace, detailed tilework, and an arched shelf. The space will glow in the evenings with the golden-hued sconces. There is a formal dining room with impressive double wood doors and original pendant light. The kitchen has an additional room perfect for a home office with a classic built-in. The bathroom has a separate stall shower and tub. This property is expansion ready with the massive three-car garage below.  The neighborhood is a treasure with a parklet at the end of the block with easy I-280 freeway access, minutes away from Glen Park BART, shops, and cafes. There is a sweet mini park at the end of the block of Cayuga and Lamartine.
